Hmm. "first_insert_time" — with per-entry expiry, the natural formulation would be "insertion time of the entry". The single scalar suggests one value for the whole ledger. With rolling semantics, the ledger behaves like a normal TTL cache. Also "Do not refresh expiry or eviction order" implies entries have individual expiry (a replay doesn't extend its life). With the global-constant reading, "refresh expiry" wouldn't make sense either.

I'm confident in rolling/per-entry expiry. 

Hmm, but wait. There's a third possible reading: first_insert_time = the insertion time of the oldest *live* entry, but recomputed only... that's what I do. OK.

content.text: The example passes. Now let me fix a bug I spotted in quoted display-name escapes (`\` + space should be invalid) and display-name token splitting:

arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='main.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = '''        if c == "\\\\":
            if i + 1 < n:
                nxt = s[i + 1]
                if nxt == "\\t" or (" " <= nxt <= "~" and nxt != " "):
                    i += 2
                    continue
                if nxt == " ":
                    i += 2
                    continue
            raise FieldError("bad escape in quoted display name")'''
new = '''        if c == "\\\\":
            if i + 1 < n:
                nxt = s[i + 1]
                if nxt == "\\t" or ("!" <= nxt <= "~"):
                    i += 2
                    continue
            raise FieldError("bad escape in quoted display name")'''
assert old in s, "pattern not found"
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)

old2 = '''def check_unquoted_dn(dn):
    toks = dn.split(" ")
    got = []
    for t in toks:
        if t:
            got.append(t)
    if not got:
        raise FieldError("empty display name")
    for t in got:
        if TOKEN_RE.fullmatch(t) is None:
            raise FieldError("bad unquoted display name token")'''
new2 = '''def check_unquoted_dn(dn):
    got = dn.split()
    if not got:
        raise FieldError("empty display name")
    for t in got:
        if TOKEN_RE.fullmatch(t) is None:
            raise FieldError("bad unquoted display name token")'''
assert old2 in s
s = s.replace(old2, new2, 1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print("patched")
EOF
